gpu.H: max(0, elapsed_preflight - loop_seconds_B - loop_seconds_R3c), entire amount assigned conservatively to each model
gpu.memory_guard: require observed GPU reservation <= 0.90 * device capacity; host estimate max(1.5 * observed_peak_GiB, 1.5 * 19 + 4) <= 60
gpu.limitation: four train records are not representative of all sessions; estimate is not a runtime bound

cpu.B: entire benchmark job elapsed seconds; at least the sum of statistics and three-eigensystem seconds for all four readers

stop: If the rounded estimate exceeds the cap, stop instead of truncating the request. No val performance influences resources.
